g.text: PWM_OE HIGH should disable output; resolve breakout pull-downs before fitting R401. Signal disable is not an E-stop.

g.text: J401/J402 are external contactor power terminals, not a PCB jumper. Do not bypass the missing contactor or safety circuit.

g.desc: J401/J402 are external contactor power terminals, not a PCB jumper. Do not bypass the missing contactor or safety circuit.

g.text: Safety controller, two NC E-stop channels, reset, watchdog hardware, coil driver and suppression are NOT DESIGNED here.

g.text: T12 battery/control wiring remains completely separate. Smart servos may replace J407/PCA9685; voltage and stall currents TBD.
